title: Event probability bounded by expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $Y:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $Y(x)\ge0$ for every $x\in\Omega$. For any real number $a$, $a$ times the probability of the event $\{x\in\Omega:a\le Y(x)\}$ is at most the expectation of $Y$ under $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
